newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan police find actress' daughter dead.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan police find actress' daughter dead.

text.p: Police found the body of the daughter of Taiwan actress Pai Ping-ping late on Monday, two weeks after the 16-year-old was kidnapped in a US$5 million ransom case.
Police said the two main suspects in the case remained at large.
Pai Hsiao-yen, the only daughter of the actress and talk show hostess, was kidnapped on April 14 on her way to school.
"We have confirmed the body is Pai Hsiao-yen," state-television quoted coroner Yang Jih-sung and the victim's family as saying at the scene.
Pai Hsiao-yen's body was found floating in a river in Taipei county. She had been dead four to five days, the television said.
The kidnappers chopped off half the victim's left little finger, sent it to her mother and demanded the $5 million ransom, one of the highest ever on the island.
Police arrested four suspects on Friday night, but the two main suspects, who are believed to have held the victim hostage, escaped.
Pai Ping-ping, a popular Taiwan actress, hosts several television talk and variety shows.
The kidnapping shocked the island and senior officials, including President Lee Teng-hui, have expressed their concerns over the deteriorating social order.
Taiwan reported 156 kidnapping cases in 1996, the highest number since 187 cases in 1990, the state-run Central News Agency has said.
In January and February, 34 kidnapping cases were reported, all of which had been solved, it said.
